name: I Spy
description: A pair of intelligence agents posing as a tennis pro and his coach go on secret missions around the world.

videos.title: So Long, Patrick Henry
videos.overview: A defector in old Hong Kong claims the attention of Robinson & Scott.

videos.title: A Cup of Kindness
videos.overview: One of their own has joined the adverse party, so Scott & Robinson are sent to Hong Kong after him.

videos.title: Carry Me Back to Old Tsing-Tao
videos.overview: A businessman in Hong Kong owes the IRS; Robinson & Scott carry the loot.

videos.title: Chrysanthemum
videos.overview: A French spy hampers the search for missing files.

videos.title: Dragon's Teeth
videos.overview: A murder happens in front of them, and Robinson & Scott must investigate a mysterious organization.

videos.title: The Loser
videos.overview: A nightclub singer is a pawn between drug smugglers (who have kidnapped Scott) and the pair.

videos.title: Danny Was a Million Laughs
videos.overview: A bodyguard assignment for a very unpleasant sort of fellow.

videos.title: The Time of the Knife
videos.overview: An agent is killed, the microfilm is missing, his girlfriend is threatened.

videos.title: No Exchange on Damaged Merchandise
videos.overview: A prisoner exchange requires a search for a double agent.

videos.title: Tatia
videos.overview: Vietnam has not seen three agents assigned there, and Scott suspects Robinson's girlfriend.

videos.title: Weight of the World
videos.overview: A Tokyo seminar on obesity is threatened with a new form of Chinese plague.

videos.title: Three Hours on a Sunday Night
videos.overview: Missing microfilm must be paid for or Scott will be killed, but where to get the shekels?

videos.title: Tigers of Heaven
videos.overview: An anti-American group in Japan menaces the last of the aristocracy.

videos.title: Affair in T'Sien Cha
videos.overview: An American schoolteacher, an ancient walled city, a missing train and a valuable cargo lost in China.

videos.title: The Tiger
videos.overview: A definitive mission to Vietnam in order to rescue the daughter of a physician.

videos.title: The Barter
videos.overview: Russian defector for American girl: good business or not?

videos.title: Always Say Goodbye
videos.overview: A womanizing American hampers efforts to protect a Japanese economic conference from Communist sabotage.

videos.title: Court of the Lion
videos.overview: A Zulu (Oxon.) who trades diamonds for revenge, a gangster dominating a small village, and radioactive isotopes.

videos.title: Turkish Delight
videos.overview: Who is kidnapping the great agronomists in Mexico City?

videos.title: Bet Me a Dollar
videos.overview: They bet each other a dollar that one can evade the other for a week, but he's been contaminated with anthrax and must be found in 24 hours.

videos.title: Return to Glory
videos.overview: An exiled South American dictator has plans, or has he, really?

videos.title: The Conquest of Maude Murdock
videos.overview: A redoubtable Embassy figure in Mexico deals them a turn.

videos.title: A Day Called 4 Jaguar
videos.overview: Quetzalcoatl has appeared in the Mexican jungle, or is it an AWOL cosmonaut pursued by his old comrades?

videos.title: Crusade to Limbo
videos.overview: Infiltrate a revolutionary South American group, with Hollywood connections, that's the assignment.

videos.title: My Mother, the Spy
videos.overview: An agent abroad and pregnant with information must report to the boys back home after her affair with the adverse party.

videos.title: There Was a Little Girl
videos.overview: Bodyguard work for a VIP's daughter. She buys an objet d'art, and hell ensues.

videos.title: It's All Done with Mirrors
videos.overview: Robinson is brainwashed to kill Scott, whose orders are to kill Robinson.

videos.title: One Thousand Fine
videos.overview: Gold fever among old friends in the jungles of Mexico.

videos.title: So Coldly Sweet
videos.overview: The phonybaloney defector is a real target when the game turns serious.

videos.title: Lori
videos.overview: Six demolitions experts down, one to go, and his sister the only lead.

videos.title: Sophia
videos.overview: Scott's foster daughter in Rome is about to be married, and he's in a great deal of trouble.

videos.title: Vendetta
videos.overview: A family court settles an old Italian grudge.

videos.title: A Gift from Alexander
videos.overview: A literary masterpiece is out of the Soviet Union, will our boys kindly retrieve it?

videos.title: Trial by Treehouse
videos.overview: Smuggler plans citywide blackout.

videos.title: Sparrowhawk
videos.overview: Las Vegas on vacation with a king as bodyguards, and an assassin's menace.

videos.title: Will the Real Good Guys Please Stand Up?
videos.overview: Desperate measures to kidnap a scientist: faux Scotty and Kelly!

videos.title: Bridge of Spies
videos.overview: In a tour of Venice, the old orthodontist gives Robinson a guide with a watch, a special watch, the kind that bugs spies.

videos.title: One of Our Bombs Is Missing
videos.overview: A very delicate dilemma, an atom bomb lost in a plane crash near an Italian village.

videos.title: To Florence, with Love (1)
videos.overview: Squiring a Leonardo to Florence.

videos.title: To Florence, with Love (2)
videos.overview: Now, to replace the faux Leonardo in the museum with the real one in our hands.

videos.title: Lisa
videos.overview: A Grecian mail order bride may be a Trojan horse.

videos.title: Little Boy Lost
videos.overview: Lonely little tyke borrows a guidance system to attract his father's attention. The adverse party is interested.

videos.title: Father Abraham
videos.overview: Young agent is bait in trap set for KGB, but his father is not in on the setup.

videos.title: Rome ... Take Away Three
videos.overview: Blackmail and murder at the U.S. Embassy.

videos.title: Tonia
videos.overview: A most prickly diversion. Scott has fallen in love with a radical expatriate, Robinson disapproves, Scott resigns. Her cell leader welcomes discord; she is murdered, Robinson is blamed.

videos.title: Child Out of Time
videos.overview: Little girl gifted with memory holds the Nazi past in her keeping.

videos.title: The Trouble with Temple
videos.overview: The trouble with Temple is her boyfriend is evil.

videos.title: The War Lord
videos.overview: Photojournalism brings in money, but the photojournalist is held captive.

videos.title: A Room with a Rack
videos.overview: Torture pure and simple has Robinson down in the dumps, with his career in jeopardy.

videos.title: Mainly on the Plains
videos.overview: Don Quixote is the fascination of a professor with vital plans and an errant mind.

videos.title: Get Thee to a Nunnery
videos.overview: Yanks vs. Brits after Nazi art treasures in a convent garden.

videos.title: Blackout
videos.overview: Flashback on a murdered ballerina, Soviet style?

videos.title: Magic Mirror
videos.overview: Difficult situation, lover tied to exiled strongman dealing in opposing missiles.

videos.title: Night Train to Madrid
videos.overview: USO tour interrupted by adverse machinations toward angry comedian.

videos.title: Casanova from Canarsie
videos.overview: Mata Hari vs. file clerk.

videos.title: Cops and Robbers
videos.overview: Old home week with the adverse party next door.

videos.title: Let's Kill Karlovassi
videos.overview: Assassinating a double agent on the beach in the Aegean just doesn't sound like fun.

videos.title: The Beautiful Children
videos.overview: Deep cover agent is blown, won't leave sideline.

videos.title: Laya
videos.overview: A very small person on the Embassy staff becomes a very large factor in espionage plans.

videos.title: The Medarra Block
videos.overview: A mysterious stone cube holds the key to rebellion against the Moroccan government.

videos.title: Philotimo
videos.overview: The best you can say about a child prodigy who takes you for a ride is maybe he's defective, after all.

videos.title: The Honorable Assassins
videos.overview: To Marrakesh with an old man's cash and his daughter and some bandits after the old man.

videos.title: Now You See Her, Now You Don't
videos.overview: Betrayal and deduction on the trail of an absconded mathematician last seen on the isle of Mykonos.

videos.title: Red Sash of Courage
videos.overview: On the border between Greece and Yugoslavia, airplane trouble besets USAF flights. Worse than that, who has been sleeping with the mayor's daughter?

videos.title: The Seventh Captain
videos.overview: Anti-submarine warfare and mysterious assassinations.

videos.title: Apollo
videos.overview: Undercover counterspying at NASA with an ex-wife as beard, who disappears.

videos.title: Oedipus at Colonus
videos.overview: A holy leader of men dies apparently on the eve of religious fighting in Morocco.

videos.title: The Lotus Eater
videos.overview: Robinson takes a powder and calls it quits in the Greek archipelago.

videos.title: An American Empress
videos.overview: San Francisco, the Empress of China, fireworks, the Reds.

videos.title: Home to Judgement
videos.overview: Pursued all the way down on the farm, Robinson & Scott fend off attackers.

videos.title: Anyplace I Hang Myself Is Home
videos.overview: Bouts of depression hit Scott too hard for anything but counseling. He and Robinson independently remember training school.

videos.title: Tag, You're It
videos.overview: Hare & hounds in San Francisco with the cadets, a charming tourist and a ringer.

videos.title: A Few Miles West of Nowhere
videos.overview: A nuclear power station is planned for the desert, but an operative is dead on the scene. The town is tight and runs the boys out, but they keep plugging.

videos.title: This Guy Smith
videos.overview: Vacationing at a mountain retreat, they strike at an adverse communications officer, who strikes back with a frame.

videos.title: Turnabout for Traitors
videos.overview: Setup as a sellout, down and out in Acapulco. The adverse party has its front men not to be recognized from your own.

videos.title: Happy Birthday... Everybody
videos.overview: Protecting the retired agent and family against the deranged and vengeful gotten loose on the streets.

videos.title: Shana
videos.overview: She has a bit of top secret propellant, the Communists have her brother.

videos.title: The Name of the Game
videos.overview: Why, says the ex-general, don't they let us fight? He will have game, let it be us, or Robinson & Scott.

videos.title: Suitable for Framing
videos.overview: Faux Senator is arranged to assassinate a President.

videos.title: The Spy Business
videos.overview: Army Intelligence is receiving hits on its defector, who is leaving clues to his whereabouts, Robinson's old buddy, the other S2 debriefer?

videos.title: Carmelita Is One of Us
videos.overview: The baby has now a microdot left by her father, and the assassins won't stop there.

videos.title: Pinwheel
videos.overview: What is this ring of spies set up in Africa? Melanie knows, or thinks she knows, or anyway means to find out, why not?

awards: Won 4 Primetime Emmys. 5 wins & 23 nominations total
